metrics.label: synthetic-controlled
metrics.caveat: Paired held-out observations only. Delayed failure is a proxy affected by forgetting; do not mix it with human labels. Wilson intervals assume independent observations; repeated learners require cluster bootstrap for inference. Synthetic fixtures must be disclosed and cannot support real-user efficacy claims.

caveat: 30 authored answer controls, 10 concepts, no real learners or human blind review. Baseline gets ordinary quiz answers; candidate gets a separate trap answer. This compares product screening flows, not the causal effect of role isolation. Strict verifier failures are abstentions. Initial mastery is a synthetic assumption. No answer or label is sent to Generator/Verifier except their whitelisted inputs. Cases within each of ten concepts are correlated; sample-level Wilson intervals are descriptive, not a population claim. End-to-end recall counts verifier rejection as non-detection. This is the specialist detector, not the combined course mastery score. Human agreement is unmeasured.
